# Repository Guide

## Project structure

This repository is a Portuguese-language archive of SENAC course material, not an application. Course content is grouped in numbered, instructor-named directories (currently `01-Vaamond` and `02-Zappa`); their `README` files identify the instructor, while the other files hold notes and examples. The root `README.md` describes the repository, and `senac-tit.md` contains student information.

The Vaamond material includes Linux server-administration notes: numbered questions, shell commands, and captured command output. Keep new material with the corresponding instructor/course rather than introducing an unrelated application structure.

## Build, test, and lint

There are no configured build, test, or lint commands in the repository. No single-test command is available.

## Content conventions

- Write course material in Portuguese, consistent with the existing notes.
- In the Linux administration notes, retain the numbered question format and keep the command and its resulting output together.
- Preserve the existing numbered instructor-directory organization when adding course material.
